symptomShortText: AOI found solder bridges on QFN pins of boards printed on PRINTER1 - understencil wipe vacuum blocked

defect.defectText: Solder bridging short circuit on fine-pitch QFN package

causesIshikawa.description: Line operator ran the standard print program PRG-900-A
WC-SMT-02-PRINTER1 understencil wipe vacuum filter clogged - vacuum -8 kPa vs min -25 kPa, paste smeared under the stencil apertures
Wipe frequency every 5 prints per DOC-6120 Rev A, unchanged
Solder paste lot SP-2207 viscosity within datasheet
SPI machine SPI-02 verified with golden board

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did solder bridges form on the QFN pins?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Solder paste volume was 152% against 80-120%, so neighbouring pads merged during reflow

fiveWhyChain.question: Why was paste volume too high only on PRINTER1?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Paste built up under the stencil because the understencil wipe did not remove it

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did the understencil wipe fail? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The wipe vacuum filter was clogged, vacuum fell to -8 kPa, and no PM task covered the filter

actions.actionText: Hold all PCBA-900 boards from batch B-50470 and perform 100% X-ray inspection of QFN solder
Replace clogged understencil wipe vacuum filter on WC-SMT-02-PRINTER1 and verify -25 kPa vacuum
Add solder paste volume alarm with automatic wipe trigger from SPI to all SMT print stations

fmeaLink.description: Solder bridging from paste smear under the stencil

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: SPI volume trend per printer pointed to PRINTER1 before AOI rejects piled up
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Wipe vacuum was not monitored and the filter had no replacement interval

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: QFN U12 pins - WC-SMT-02-PRINTER1 - batch B-50470, June 2026
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: WC-SMT-02-PRINTER2 - same stencil design and same paste lot SP-2207
isIsNot.notes: Defect follows the printer, not the paste or stencil design
